svg.aria-label: Fig 1, Shipping an AI agent. An isometric bench machine: a request card drops from a hopper onto a carriage; the carriage stops under the agent core, which lifts a tool cartridge from a rack and pulls a drawer from a card catalogue, each answering along a cable; a dial gauge checks the result; the card is fed into an output box and a light runs down a cable into a server rack whose lights come on.
